posts.author: Kyuubits
posts.body:
Why don't you put the reading animation in the second row of the idle animation section instead of the walking section?
If you want to switch back to the idle animation after the reading, you can have 2 character sprite sheets (one with Reading and the other with Idle) and then Change Character Image in an Event Command to the one that has the actual Idle anim.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
As a tip, the
section guidelines
ask you to provide links to the plugins you're talking about, to make it easier for others to help you.
You don't need a plugin to do this.
Set the event image to the character sheet that has the reading motion, and check Stepping for it to go through the frames.
